extension.summary: Smooth Prime: Prime Video in the Aurora Cinema interface
extension.description: Smooth Prime is maintained by AgreeWithScotty. Catalog, account authentication, HTTPS transport, media resources, Widevine license relay, subtitles and playback lifecycle use independently written implementations. The dedicated Aurora interface is adapted from Scott's SmoothFlix. Not affiliated with Amazon. See NOTICE.md for asset and dependency licenses.
extension.disclaimer: Uses your own Amazon account and Kodi InputStream Adaptive with Widevine. Not affiliated with Amazon.
extension.news: 0.2.64[CR]- Automatically download pinned regular Chrome 158.0.8127.89 directly from Google on first Windows x64 HD playback; no separate Chrome installation.[CR]- Verify the Google payload and every private runtime file; reuse the fixed version independently of system browser updates.[CR]- Show cancellable first-use setup with atomic installation, interrupted-download recovery and temporary-file cleanup.[CR]- Keep HD playback in stock Kodi with the owned CDM adapter; do not modify Kodi, InputStream Adaptive or a system browser.[CR]- Include the unmodified 7-Zip extractor, license and exact source; distribute no Google Chrome or Widevine binaries.[CR]- Preserve accumulated region, Watchlist, season loading, sign-in catalog refresh, Back/resume, title sizing and original artwork fixes.[CR]- Expand redacted download, integrity, extraction, cancellation, native playback and quality diagnostics.
